population_rule: all valid scheduler submissions; execution matching is a post-event audit

capacity_stress_panel.solver: scipy.optimize.milp with binary start variables and exact contiguous fixed-rate blocks

interpretation: The central q50 declaration is a training-only ex-ante entitlement; the q10 declaration is an empirical lower coverage envelope and the full requested nameplate is the physical upper bound. Observed DCGM energy is reported for coverage and cannot alter a release, deadline, or service equality. The stress floor is the larger of the 0.004-MWh absolute floor and 0.25 of the cohort entitlement; for this locked cohort the absolute floor binds. The panel is solved with one binary start per job, so capacity and the event-service floor are tested on an executable nonpreemptive schedule.
